contract_name: Wave 21 Agent 1 — Chat Router Integration Contract

supported_message_types.behavior: Sets active context session and binds CHAT_SESSION context var

payload.revert_to_revision: optional int (historical revision target for rollback)

supported_message_types.behavior: Calls KnowledgeChatOrchestrator.revise_deliverable() in-place on the same canonical Project without creating duplicate projects.
Invokes KnowledgeChatOrchestrator.handle_video_request() when creative motion generation intention is parsed.

payload.state: string (enum: REQUESTED, PLANNING, RETRIEVING_KNOWLEDGE, COMPOSING, VALIDATING, RENDERING, VIDEO_VERIFIED, REVIEW_READY, BLOCKED_RIGHTS, PENDING_CREDENTIALS, BLOCKED)
payload.library_ids: array of strings (all deliverables in multi-clip runs)

handle_video_request.method: async def handle_video_request(request_or_message: Union[VideoRequestContract, str], authenticated_context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, authorizations: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, preferences: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, project_id: Optional[str] = None, allow_test_fixture: bool = True) -> KnowledgeOrchestratorResponse

revise_deliverable.method: async def revise_deliverable(request_or_run_id: Union[RevisionRequestContract, str], user_feedback: Optional[str] = None, expected_revision: Optional[int] = None, authenticated_context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, authorizations: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, allow_test_fixture: bool = True) -> KnowledgeOrchestratorResponse

agent_5_patch_instructions.description: Agent 5 must ensure that /ws/chat forwards revision_request and creative video requests to KnowledgeChatOrchestrator and broadcasts oaas_outcome_update frames with truthful state, project_id, revision, and deliverable_url. Note that backend/api/chat.py already imports and calls KnowledgeChatOrchestrator.revise_deliverable under revision_request in the current tree.
